thread:
lee: Heads-up — observability playground page has two 404s and an SDK snippet using removed API. Will open a PR.

linkchecker-bot: scan: /console/playground/kv-cache -> 404, /docs/examples/tracehook-legacy -> 404.

lee: Current snippet calls `client.prefetch(...)` which no longer exists. New API is `client.kv_lookup(...)` and returns a list of items with `key`, `value`, `latency_ms`.

toni: can you paste both old and new snippets so I can update the cost/latency calc example?

lee: old:
```
client.prefetch('sess', max_prefix=512)
```
new:
```
items = client.kv_lookup('sess', max_items=5)
# items -> [{"key":"k","value":"v","latency_ms":3}, ...]
```

kevin: add a small compatibility shim showing how to transform to the old dict shape for downstream code. also add a frontmatter redirect for the missing page.

maya: I can open PR this afternoon: include redirect, update snippet, add compat example, attach a tiny trace PNG showing `key` attr, and run link-check CI.

ops-bot: PR created: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4999 (title: "playground: migrate prefetch -> kv_lookup, fix 404s, add compat shim").

toni: quick review planned after CI passes. suggest a one-line changelog at top of page: "SDK: prefetch -> kv_lookup migration notes."

lee: thanks — assigning SDK and docs reviewers. will also add a QA note to check cost/latency sample math.
